Main battle tank: six large road wheels, angular sloped low turret, longer sleek hull than light tank. Compose body centered in upper two-thirds, cannon centered in lower third, both fully visible with generous margins. Do not repeat animation frames. Do not draw soldiers. This is a replacement asset; geometry and typography from atlas need not be retained, only tank identity and game art style.
